sources.title: MuJoCo Menagerie Unitree H1 model
sources.version_or_date: accessed 2026-09-13; live page, no revision pin claimed
sources.specific_reference: Model origin only. Local authority is AA1/assets/mjcf/h1/h1.xml and scene.xml: free pelvis, 19 torque motors, four-joint arms, no hand joints. Distal forearm collision sphere at local [0.28,0,-0.015] on each elbow link. No upstream/local revision equivalence asserted.

sources.title: HumanoidBench locomotion task implementations
sources.version_or_date: accessed 2026-09-13; live page, no revision pin claimed
sources.specific_reference: Classes Walk, Stand, Run, Crawl, Hurdle, Sit, Stair and Slide. The public repository lists no-hand h1 tasks. We adapt operations only; original reward formulas, success bars, controller rates and task geometry are not reused.

sources.title: HumanoidBench reaching task
sources.version_or_date: accessed 2026-09-13; live page, no revision pin claimed
sources.specific_reference: Reach task implementation; endpoint-to-goal reaching. Local forearm endpoint replaces a hand reference; source hand morphology is not assumed.

sources.title: HumanoidBench maze task

sources.specific_reference: MazeBase and Maze: ordered checkpoints through a multi-turn corridor.

sources.title: HumanoidBench balance tasks
sources.version_or_date: accessed 2026-09-13; live page, no revision pin claimed

sources.title: HumanoidBench pole avoidance task
sources.version_or_date: accessed 2026-09-13; live page, no revision pin claimed

sources.title: HumanoidBench box-pushing task
sources.version_or_date: accessed 2026-09-13; live page, no revision pin claimed
sources.specific_reference: Push.goal_dist and Push.get_reward: move a tabletop box to a declared target through reaching/contact.

sources.title: Safety Gym task and constraint implementations
sources.version_or_date: accessed 2026-09-13; live page, no revision pin claimed
sources.specific_reference: Engine goal/button/circle tasks, goal_met, reward and cost; hazards are excluded areas and gremlins are moving obstacles. Source robot is not H1; source numerical settings are not adopted.
